title: Natural Language Issue Understanding
story: As a requestor, I want to describe my issue in my own words, so that I do not need to select forms, categories, or predefined options.

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am in a conversation with the AI Assistant
acceptanceCriteria.when: I describe my issue in natural language
acceptanceCriteria.then: the assistant identifies my intent from the input

acceptanceCriteria.given: the assistant has low confidence in identifying my intent
I describe a request that is out of scope
acceptanceCriteria.then: it clearly identifies it as out-of-scope and provides appropriate escalation paths

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am in a multi-turn conversation
acceptanceCriteria.then: the assistant maintains conversation context throughout the interaction

edgeCases: Input with typos and grammatical errors
Contradictory information in the same message
Profanity or inappropriate content in input
